Line 3. Enter spouse’s or R D P’s S S N or I T I N above and full name here.
Line 6. If someone can claim you (or your spouse or R D P) as a dependent, check the box here. See instructions.
Exemptions. Line 7. Personal: If you checked box 1, 3, or 4 above, enter 1 in the box. If you checked box 2 or 5, enter 2 in the box. If you checked the box on line 6, see instructions.
Multiply the number you put in the line 7 box by $153. Enter this number into this field. Whole dollars only.
Line 8. Blind: If you (or your spouse or R D P) are visually impaired, enter 1; if both are visually impaired, enter 2. See instructions.
Multiply the number you put in the line 8 box by $153. Enter this number into this field.
Line 9. Senior: If you (or your spouse or R D P) are 65 or older, enter 1; if both are 65 or older, enter 2. See instructions.
Multiply the number you put in the line 9 box by $153. Enter this number into this field.
Line 10. Dependents: Do not include yourself or your spouse or R D P. Dependent One, first name.
Dependent Two, First name.
Dependent Three, First name.
Dependent One, Last name.

Multiply the number of total dependent exemptions you put in the box by $475. Enter this number into this field. Whole dollars only.

Line 11. Exemption amount: Add line 7 through line 10.
Total Taxable Income. Line 12. Total California wages from your federal Form or Forms W-2, box 16.
Line 13. Enter federal adjusted gross income (A G I) from federal Form 1040, 1040-S R, or 1040-N R, line 11b.
Line 14. California adjustments – subtractions. Enter the amount from Schedule CA (540 N R), Part Two, line 27, column B.
Line 15. Subtract line 14 from line 13. If less than zero, enter the result in parentheses. See instructions.
Line 16. California adjustments – additions. Enter the amount from Schedule CA (540 N R), Part Two, line 27, column C.
Line 17. Adjusted gross income from all sources. Combine line 15 and line 16.
Line 18. Enter the larger of: Your California itemized deductions from Schedule CA (540 N R), Part Three, line 30; OR Your California standard deduction. See instructions.
Line 19. Subtract line 18 from line 17. This is your total taxable income. If less than zero, enter 0 .
California Taxable Income. Line 31. Tax. Check the box if from Tax Table.
Line 31. Check the box if from Tax Rate Schedule.
Line 31. Check the box if from FTB 3800.
Line 31. Check the box if from FTB 3803.
Line 31. Tax amount.
Line 32. California adjusted gross income from Schedule CA (540 N R), Part 4, line 1.
Line 35. California Taxable Income from Schedule CA (540 N R), Part 4, line 5.
Line 36. California Tax Rate. Divide line 31 by line 19.  Enter digit before decimal point.
Line 36. Enter 4 digits after decimal point .
Line 37. California Tax Before Exemption Credits. Multiply line 35 by line 36.
Line 38. California Exemption Credit Percentage. Divide line 35 by line 19. If more than 1, enter 1.0000. Enter digit before decimal point.
Line 38. Enter 4 digits after decimal point .
Line 39. California Prorated Exemption Credits. Multiply line 11 by line 38. If the amount on line 13 is more than $252,203, see instructions.
Line 40. California Regular Tax Before Credits. Subtract line 39 from line 37. If less than zero, enter 0 .
Line 41. Tax. See instructions. Check the box if from Schedule G-1.
Line 41. Check the box if from FTB 5870A.
Line 41. Tax amount.
Line 42. Add line 40 and line 41.
Special Credits. Line 50. Nonrefundable Child and Dependent Care Expenses Credit. See instructions. Attach form FTB 3506.
Line 51. Credit for joint custody head of household. See instructions.
Line 52. Credit for dependent parent. See instructions.
Line 53. Credit for senior head of household. See instructions.
Line 54. Credit percentage. Enter the amount from line 38 here. If more than 1, enter 1.0000. See instructions. Enter digit before decimal point.
Line 54. Enter 4 digits after decimal point .
Line 55. Credit amount. See instructions.
Line 58. Enter credit name.
Line 58. Enter credit code.

Line 59. Enter credit code.
Line 59. Enter credit amount.
Line 60. To claim more than two credits, see instructions. Attach Schedule P (540 N R).
Line 61. Nonrefundable Renter’s Credit. See instructions.
Line 62. Add line 50 and line 55 through line 61. These are your total credits.
Line 63. Subtract line 62 from line 42. If less than zero, enter 0.
Other Taxes. Line 71. Alternative Minimum Tax. Attach Schedule P (540 N R).
Line 72. Behavioral Health Services Tax. See instructions.
Line 73. Other taxes and credit recapture. See instructions.
Line 74. Add line 63, line 71, line 72, and line 73. This is your total tax.
Payments. Line 81. California income tax withheld. See instructions.
Line 82. 2025 California estimated tax and other payments. See instructions.
Line 83. Withholding (Form 592-B and/or Form 593). See instructions.
Line 84. Refundable Program 4.0 California Motion Picture and Television Production Credit. See instructions.
Line 85. Earned Income Tax Credit (E I T C). See instructions.
Line 86. Young Child Tax Credit (Y C T C). See instructions.
Line 87. Foster Youth Tax Credit (F Y T C). See instructions.
Line 88. Add line 81 through line 87. These are your total payments. See instructions.

Individual Shared Responsibility Penalty. Line 91. If you and your household had full-year health care coverage, check the box. See instructions. Medicare Part A or C coverage is qualifying health care coverage. If you did not check the box, see instructions.
Line 91. Individual Shared Responsibility (I S R) Penalty. See instructions.
Overpaid Tax or Tax Due. Line 92. Payments after Individual Shared Responsibility Penalty. If line 88 is more than line 91, subtract line 91 from line 88.
Line 93. Individual Shared Responsibility Penalty Balance. If line 91 is more than line 88, subtract line 88 from line 91.
Line 101. Overpaid tax. If line 92 is more than line 74, subtract line 74 from line 92.
Line 102. Amount of line 101 you want applied to your 2026 estimated tax.
Line 103. Overpaid tax available this year. Subtract line 102 from line 101.
Line 104. Tax due. If line 92 is less than line 74, subtract line 92 from line 74.
